artifact.summary: No Qiskit circuit was generated. The specification describes a classical compilation and optimization flow (ULB size selection by weighted latency, DAG scheduling with routing delays, force-directed scheduling). It defines no quantum register, unitary operation, initial state or gate-level construction, so there is nothing to implement as a measurement-free unitary build_circuit(instance).

equation_mapping.explanation: Classical frequency-weighted latency sum for ULB size selection. It has no unitary or qubit-level meaning. The latency model L(o,s) and the weighting are also unspecified.
Classical argmin over candidate ULB sizes. It is not a quantum operation.
Classical precedence constraint with routing latency in a scheduling DAG. The routing latency depends on an unspecified placement and architecture model.
Standard makespan definition for DAG scheduling. It is context only and not a circuit construction.
Classical force-directed scheduling force. The paper's modified version is unspecified, and it does not correspond to any quantum gate sequence.
